0022600212.text: The Celtics (8-2, on a three-game winning streak and 3-2 on the road) visit the 76ers (9-2), who sit first in the East and the Atlantic, in the Celtics' 11th game of the season, with Boston 0.5 games back in the division. The season series has no games yet in 2026-27, was split 2-2 in 2025-26, and in the 2025-26 playoffs the Celtics lost 3-4, most recently a 109-100 loss in Boston on May 2, 2026. Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), while no Celtics players are listed as unavailable.
